summary: Static code inspection of /app/app/(tabs)/availability.tsx for the scrollable 28-day strip fix. Expo Web app UI cannot be Playwright-driven in this preview pod (per agent_to_agent_context_note), so acceptance was done via file inspection and grep verification. All four acceptance criteria pass: (1) day strip is a horizontal ScrollView with data-testid='availability-day-strip' rendering a 28-day dayList; (2) selectedDate is a Date state and selectedDay is derived as (selectedDate.getDay()+6)%7 and used in openAdd, slot filtering, and DAYS_FULL indexing; (3) per-day dot indicator uses the day's own weekday, today+selected highlight via sameDay; (4) recurring weekly model preserved — slots keyed by day_of_week 0..6, backend payload unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: L277-283: ScrollView is correctly configured — horizontal, showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}, data-testid='availability-day-strip'. contentContainerStyle=weekStripContent with paddingHorizontal:12 gives comfortable edge padding; flexGrow:0 on the outer style prevents the strip from stretching vertically.
L248-252: dayList = Array.from({length:28}, (_, i) => new Date(today) + i days) — correctly produces 28 consecutive dates starting today, giving providers visibility into the next 4 weeks.
L294: each cell has data-testid=`day-cell-${idx}` (matches spec).

L122-126: today is normalized (setHours 0,0,0,0); selectedDate initialized to today; selectedDay = (selectedDate.getDay()+6)%7 derives 0=Mon…6=Sun purely from selectedDate — no separate selectedDay state, so it can never drift.

L285-286: hasSl uses the CELL's weekday, not selectedDay: `const dow = (d.getDay()+6)%7; slots.some(sl => sl.day_of_week === dow)` — so the dot shows on every date whose weekday has any slot, exactly as spec requires.
L287-288: isToday=sameDay(d, today) and isSel=sameDay(d, selectedDate) use year+month+date comparison (L253), so highlight logic is correct even if `today` is a fresh Date on each render.
L307-310: label shows DAYS_FULL[selectedDay] plus selectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', ...) with the ` · repeats weekly` suffix — matches spec.

L185 openAdd(day ?? selectedDay), L255 slots.filter(s => s.day_of_week === selectedDay), L307 DAYS_FULL[selectedDay], L312 openAdd(selectedDay) — every consumer of the previous selectedDay state now reads the derived value; no dead references.
grep 'weekDates|setSelectedDay' over availability.tsx returns 0 matches (matches in executors.tsx are that file's own unrelated state). No stale references remain.

Regression safety: Slot type L59-65 still has day_of_week:number (0..6); handleSave payload L217 sends {day_of_week, start_time, end_time, is_active}; hasOverlap L199-206 keys on day_of_week; openEdit L191-197 uses slot.day_of_week. The weekly recurring model and backend contract are untouched.
Styles L495-497: weekStrip (border/padding), weekStripContent (paddingHorizontal:12), dayCell width:52 — matches spec (52px fixed-width cells for horizontal scroll).

Minor perf (non-blocking): `today` and `dayList` are recomputed on every render. Wrapping `today` in useMemo(()=>{const d=new Date(); d.setHours(0,0,0,0); return d;}, []) and `dayList` in useMemo would avoid a 28-item allocation per render but is not a correctness issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 acceptance criteria verified via static inspection

context_for_next_testing_agent: Testing was static inspection only because the Expo Web app in this preview pod cannot be Playwright-driven (per main agent's agent_to_agent_context_note). The scrollable 28-day strip is implemented correctly and cleanly: single selectedDate state drives a derived selectedDay, per-cell dow is computed inline for the dot indicator, and no stale weekDates/setSelectedDay references remain. Backend availability contract is unchanged.
rca of the issue: Original bug: the day strip was a fixed 7-cell row (Mon–Sun of current week) with no ScrollView, so providers could not preview or select any date more than 6 days ahead. Fix applied by main agent: (a) replaced the 7-day row with a 28-entry dayList of consecutive Date objects starting from today; (b) wrapped it in a horizontal ScrollView (showsHorizontalScrollIndicator=false) with 52px-wide cells; (c) replaced the standalone selectedDay state with a selectedDate:Date state plus a derived selectedDay = (selectedDate.getDay()+6)%7 so all downstream logic (slot filter, openAdd, DAYS_FULL label) works unchanged; (d) dot indicator per cell now computes its OWN dow rather than reusing selectedDay so dots correctly appear on every future date whose weekday has slots. Because availability is a recurring weekly schedule keyed by day_of_week, showing 28 dates is purely a UX affordance — same weekday shares the same underlying slots — and the backend model is untouched. Verified correct by inspection.
